independent evidence or reason to withho: A pair's charge product is unchanged under simultaneous spatial inversion or reversal of both charges. Reverse one charge and the product flips. Neither operation determines which interaction is attractive.

independent evidence or reason to withho: A cubic metric remains cubic under spatial inversion. Other cubic elements falsify uniqueness. Facet morphology and crystal-system classification need separate specifications.

independent evidence or reason to withho: Unpolarized spectral wavelengths are scalars. Reversing the magnetic field exchanges appropriate signed magnetic components. It is a different operation from spatial inversion of the experiment.

readout: Metal photoemission
independent evidence or reason to withho: Emission rates and signed charge can be defined. A physical mirror preserves electric charge; polarity reversal changes the experiment. Neither operation alone predicts species-dependent thresholds.

readout: Change of chemical identity on removal of one electron
independent evidence or reason to withho: Electron removal changes charge state while keeping nuclear Z in ordinary ionization. Proton count is invariant under spatial inversion. Distinguish ionization from nuclear transmutation.

readout: Atomic size and attraction down a selected sequence
independent evidence or reason to withho: This is a trend on part of a period, and the H comparison is outside the Li–Ne ring. A definition of atomic radius and paired data are required.

readout: A piece of iron and magnetic poles
independent evidence or reason to withho: A reversal of the magnet and spatial inversion are distinct. Induced response of unmagnetized soft iron may depend on B², whereas a fixed aligned moment couples by −m·B. The unqualified single sign is insufficient.
